Aligne 4 jetons de ta couleur avant l'au: Line up 4 discs of your colour before the other player on a 7 × 6 grid, horizontally, vertically or diagonally. Against the computer, which looks 2, 4 or 6 moves ahead depending on the level, or two players on the same screen. Click or arrows and Enter, undo the last move, and a record of wins and losses per level. Discs fall and bounce with a little « clack », full screen button and a game that fits the screen.
